title: SACS: A Code Smell Dataset using Semi-automatic Generation Approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.15342v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code smell is a great challenge in software refactoring, which indicates latent design or implementation flaws that may degrade the software maintainability and evolution. Over the past of decades, the research on code smell has received extensive attention. Especially the researches applied machine learning-technique have become a popular topic in recent studies. However, one of the biggest challenges to apply machine learning-technique is the lack of high-quality code smell datasets. Manually constructing such datasets is extremely labor-intensive, as identifying code smells requires substantial development expertise and considerable time investment. In contrast, automatically generated datasets, while scalable, frequently exhibit reduced label reliability and compromised data quality. To overcome this challenge, in this study, we explore a semi-automatic approach to generate a code smell dataset with high quality data samples. Spe

translated_title: SACS：一种采用半自动生成方法构建的代码坏味数据集
translated_abstract: 代码坏味是软件重构中的一大挑战，它代表了潜在的设计或实现缺陷，可能降低软件的可维护性和演化能力。在过去几十年里，代码坏味的研究受到了广泛关注，尤其是应用机器学习技术的研究已成为近期研究的热门话题。然而，应用机器学习技术的最大挑战之一是缺乏高质量的代码坏味数据集。人工构建此类数据集极其耗费人力，因为识别代码坏味需要大量的开发专业知识和可观的时间投入。相比之下，自动生成的数据集虽然具有可扩展性，但往往存在标签可靠性降低和数据质量受损的问题。为了克服这一挑战，在本研究中，我们探索了一种半自动方法来生成具有高质量数据样本的代码坏味数据集。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种半自动生成方法，构建了高质量的代码坏味数据集SACS，从而在人工标注的高质量与自动生成的高效率之间取得了平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SACS, a high-quality code smell dataset generated through a semi-automatic approach, striking a balance between the reliability of manual labeling and the scalability of automatic generation.
